      Job Summary

      A leading Marketing Agency is looking for a highly skilled and creative Videographer & Video Editor to join its creative team. The ideal candidate must combine professional filming skills with advanced video editing expertise, taking projects from concept and on-site shooting to final production. The role requires strong technical abilities in camera operation, lighting, visual storytelling, professional editing, color grading, and motion graphics to produce high-quality video content for social media, advertising campaigns, and client projects.

      Key Responsibilities

      • Plan, shoot, and produce high-quality video content for social media, marketing campaigns, and commercial projects
      • Operate professional cameras, lenses, lighting, and audio equipment
      • Handle the complete video production process, from filming and footage selection to final editing and delivery
      • Edit videos professionally using Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and DaVinci Resolve
      • Perform advanced color correction and color grading to achieve high-quality visual results
      • Create engaging transitions, visual effects, motion graphics, and animations when required
      • Ensure professional audio editing, sound design, and synchronization
      • Adapt video content to different platforms and formats, including Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube, and advertising campaigns
      • Collaborate with the creative and marketing teams to develop visual concepts and execute creative ideas
      • Manage multiple projects while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines
      • Stay updated with the latest filming techniques, editing trends, and AI-powered video production tools

      Requirements

      • Minimum 3 years of professional experience in videography and video editing
      • Strong hands-on experience in both professional filming and advanced video editing
      • Excellent command of Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and DaVinci Resolve
      • Advanced skills in color grading, visual effects, transitions, and motion graphics
      • Strong knowledge of camera settings, lenses, lighting techniques, and audio recording
      • Ability to independently manage the entire production process, from shooting to final delivery
      • Experience producing commercial videos, promotional content, and social media videos
      • Good understanding of visual storytelling, composition, and creative direction
      • Familiarity with AI-powered video editing and production tools is an advantage
      • Strong creativity, attention to detail, and time-management skills
      • A professional portfolio or showreel demonstrating both filming and editing capabilities is required

      • Seniority level

        Mid-Senior level

      • Employment type

        Full-time

      • Industries

        Human Resources Services
